protocol.novelty: Single-layer complete Keys disjoint from 168 repository-exposed objects; predictor feature aliases reported separately
protocol.predictor: Old112 nearest mean/distance-floor q90 plus unchanged unaccepted host profile; no target-label refit
protocol.candidate_generation: Shared structural-MCTS proposal pool plus label-free probes, then sealed three-method rescoring; not ReferenceEager-guided search

execution.inputs: canonical CPU-generated tensors copied to each runtime device; same values for every plan
execution.order: rotate candidate order by workload and reverse in repeat 1
execution.selection: Union of Top4 exchange classes from each of three methods plus single-device/half-graph controls; execute both physical directions of every selected class
execution.timing: uninstrumented eager forward; synchronize all participating GPUs before/after CPU wall timer

protocol.links: reuse the existing calibrated link profile; record current GPU peer access; do not refit on holdout execution times
protocol.acceptance: complete formal two-device labels, finite and close outputs; ranking/speed targets reported even on failure
protocol.scope: independent sequence-layer validation of experimental cost predictions; no SROP benefit claim

epsilon_evaluation.reference: best measured candidate subset, never global Oracle optimum
epsilon_evaluation.physical_tie_policy: Choose lexicographically smallest physical ID before labels; also report full tie best/worst regret and exchange-class diagnostics

label_access.zero_shot: Target labels may only be consumed by measurement and evaluation, never predictors or candidate generation
label_access.active_calibration: Disabled in this bundle; a separate preregistration is required
label_access.prior_exposure: 112 train labels and 56 development full keys excluded; external/private label exposure unverified
